title: Audio Device Reader
text: Record from sound card, 2 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Device input channels} sets nondefault channel mapping; {Driver}, {Device}, {Info} sets the view information about your audio input configuration, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate your device uses to acquire audio, {Number of channels}, {Samples per frame} sets the frame size read from audio device, {Device bit depth} sets the data type used by device to acquire audio data 16-bit, {Use default channel mapping} sets the toggle channel mapping source, {Output number of samples overrun} sets the additional output port for number of samples and {Output data type} sets the data type output. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Driver
params.values: Driver used to access your audio device DirectSound (default) | ASIO | WASAPI

params.name: Device
params.values: Device used to acquire audio samples default audio device (default)

params.name: Info
params.values: View information about your audio input configuration button

params.name: Sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate your device uses to acquire audio data 44100 (default) | integer

params.name: Number of channels
params.values: Number of channels acquired by your audio device 1 (default) | integer

params.name: Samples per frame
params.values: Frame size read from audio device 1024 (default) | integer

params.name: Device bit depth
params.values: Data type used by device to acquire audio data 16-bit integer (default) | 8-bit integer | 16-bit integer | 24-bit integer | 32-bit integer

params.name: Use default channel mapping
params.values: Toggle channel mapping source on (default) | off

params.name: Device input channels
params.values: Specify nondefault channel mapping [1:MaximumInputChannels] (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Output number of samples overrun
params.values: Specify additional output port for number of samples overrun off (default) | on

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type output from block double (default) | single | int32 | int16 | uint8
